sources.title: FinCEN314b fact sheet
sources.supported_claim: Registrants must verify recipient participation and protect shared information. Ordinary314b does not authorize SAR/existence disclosure. Actual joint-SAR participants may discuss their joint SAR. Foreign safeharbor coverage and other privacy law need separate review.
